verdict.rationale: Vercel documents configurable function regions, including per-function overrides and Enterprise failover regions, plus request-time code that can rewrite or personalize responses. A developer can therefore place server code near their users. However, functions default to a single region (iad1), and no evidence describes an automatically global edge runtime that runs code at locations near each user; only cached files and images are explicitly served from the CDN close to users. Missing for 10: an explicit global edge compute or edge runtime that runs code in many locations near users, documentation that middleware executes at the edge, and independent or hands-on corroboration of edge latency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my code on a global edge network close to end users

citations.quote: You can override regions for individual functions using the functions property in your project configuration.
The default Function region is Washington, D.C., USA ( iad1 ) for all new projects.
Run code before a request completes to rewrite, redirect, or personalize responses.
Resize and convert images on demand and serve them from the CDN in modern formats.
